The '''excavated Rakata transporter''' was a transporter built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] that was uncovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The transporter was located in a cave behind the [[Maximum Security Ops Center]] in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
